demos.title: Museum Industriekultur, Nuremberg, 7 min walk, 3 floors
demos.description: Museum Industriekultur, Nuremberg: an IPIN competition validation walk (SM-G930F, IMU + Wi-Fi + barometer) over floors -2, -1, 0, taking the stairs. The first 90 s of the recording are cut, most of it before the surveyor's first landmark. Squares are the landmarks the surveyor tapped, the only ground truth; the floor menu follows the walker. Walls were extracted from the competition's floor plans and the Wi-Fi access points (purple) located from the training walks. This walk is from the set the settings were chosen on; the held-out scoring walks are in docs/ipin.md. The particle filter uses data/configs/ipin.json: the Wi-Fi settings plus the floor model (barometer jump to the nearest stairs, kept barometer reference, Wi-Fi fingerprint floor prior).

demos.title: University of Minho, building 11, 6 min walk, 3 floors
demos.description: University of Minho, building 11: an IPIN competition validation walk (Nexus 5, IMU + Wi-Fi + barometer) over floors 0, 1, 2, taking the stairs. The first 82 s of the recording are cut, most of it before the surveyor's first landmark, and the square at 0 s is interpolated between the two landmarks around the cut. Squares are the landmarks the surveyor tapped, the only ground truth; the floor menu follows the walker. Walls were extracted from the competition's floor plans and the Wi-Fi access points (purple) located from the training walks. This walk is from the set the settings were chosen on; the held-out scoring walks are in docs/ipin.md. The particle filter uses data/configs/ipin.json: the Wi-Fi settings plus the floor model (barometer jump to the nearest stairs, kept barometer reference, Wi-Fi fingerprint floor prior).
